packageRules.description: Group the four Rust crates (lightrays + the three downloaders). They share no workspace, but a bump usually lands in more than one.
Group Docker/Containerfile base images so one PR updates a base across the stack.
Group the Python backend (uv) and the docs site, which shares the toolchain.
Group GitHub Actions bumps; they are low risk and are pinned by digest via config:best-practices.

Streaming cores and emulator bases are pinned deliberately: the retro and wine images build against specific libretro/pacman state, and a surprise major there costs a long Arch rebuild to debug. Keep them on the dashboard until approved.
Python 3.13 is pinned via .python-version and must match the backend image; do not let Renovate move it without a deliberate decision.
Require manual approval for major bumps. config:best-practices groups automerge on minor/patch only, so majors would otherwise land unreviewed.
Never automerge the backend lockfile or the frontend lockfile: both carry a build toolchain that CI exercises, and a broken lock is expensive to bisect.

customManagers.description: Track the gst-wayland-display commit the lightrays compositor is pinned to. The ARG holds a SHA, so it is matched as a digest: currentValue tracks the branch it came from and Renovate proposes the latest commit on it.
DXVK release baked into the wine game container. The ARG holds the bare version while the download URL prefixes it with 'v', so only the version number is captured.
